plugins.name: nnsight
plugins.description: Neural network interpretability with nnsight and NDIF - tracing and intervening on model internals, debugging, remote execution, logit lens, activation patching, attribution patching, causal tracing, and steering

plugins.name: nnter
plugins.description: Architecture-agnostic interpretability with nnter, a layer on nnsight that gives every transformer family the same module names and standard values - usage of the values, recipes that run unchanged across families, and extending it with a new family

plugins.name: ndif
plugins.description: Self-hosting NDIF, the server behind nnsight's remote=True - standing one up with docker run, compose, or the ndif CLI; deploying, pinning and sizing models; troubleshooting; and changing the server itself
